## History

Mrs. Alexander Spencer was responsible for the initial adoption mix-up that resulted in an eleven-year-old orphan girl being sent to [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station instead of the boy [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) had expected. [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) later visited Mrs. Spencer's house alongside the girl, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), to clarify the situation.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P6](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER II.
